caption: Creamy, golden-brown tonkotsu broth with floating noodles and toppings sits in a white ceramic bowl with geometric patterned rim. Pinkish-red background forms a rounded bowl shape, while tender, pale pink chashu pork with marbled fat and slight browning rests in the broth.

segments_info.text: Pinkish-red surface with smooth texture and subtle sheen, forming a rounded bowl shape around the ramen.
Chashu pork: tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface, irregularly shaped, showing marbled fat and slight browning.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy, golden-brown, and glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with colorful geometric patterned rim, smooth surface, circular shape, and slight glaze sheen.
